modules.module_title: Operational Technology Security — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Understand OT fundamentals and the importance of security in industrial environments.
Elaborate the difference between IT and OT environments
Discuss OT network topology components
Familiarize with international standards and compliance requirements.
Learn how to implement segmentation and zone-based security and ensure OT networks are segmented from IT networks to reduce attack surface and prevent lateral movement of threats.
Maintain an inventory of all OT devices and systems, including legacy equipment and proprietary systems not on standard networks.

Evaluate the Common vulnerabilities in OT devices legacy hardware, firmware & conduct regular assessments tailored for industrial control systems, including firmware and hardware vulnerabilities unique to OT devices.
Implement strict controls over modifications to OT systems to prevent accidental or malicious changes that could impact safety or operations

Deploy OT-optimized intrusion detection systems IDS and continuous monitoring solutions capable of handling real-time data flows and specialized protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, Proprietary protocols and detect and respond to OT security incidents.
Balance security with operational safety.
